items.title: Choir Auditions
items.body:
CHORAL AUDITIONS FOR 2027 – Bel Canto

This is only for current year 11 and 12’s (year 10’s will get a chance in a couple of weeks)

If you have a treble voice and would like a chance to sing in Bel Canto in 2027 then please sign up for an audition. If you are not sure if it is your thing, just audition anyway – you do not have to accept a place in the choir if you are offered one.

Give it a go, you have nothing to lose!

Bel Canto is for year 11-13 students who sing soprano or alto.

The auditions are on during senior exams. Please sign up for an audition time that suits you. Auditions start on Friday Nov 6th.

The sign-up sheets are on the windows outside M1. All the information you need to know is on those sign-up sheets.

Seniors, please sign up before you leave for exams OR email Miss Densem to book a time. - sude@burnside.school.nz

I look forward to hearing you sing.

Miss Densem.
items.author: KRG

items.title: Burnside Rowing Squad - Learn to Row Dates!
items.body:
Did you miss out on joining Burnside Rowing? Its not too late

We are once again looking for new people to join our rowing squad for the upcoming season! If you are interested in rowing or coxing and are a current student, come along to one (or both!) of our learn to rows! No experience required, all year levels welcome!

Email Coach Christina to schedule a couple days to try rowing out!

Trainings are at the Avon Rowing Club (BHS Rowing Shed) on Kerrs Road, Wainoni

Email Head Coach Christina Blackford if you have any questions - christina.bakerburns@gmail.com

Or email Captains Tom Carey - 23160@burnside.school.nz or Melissa Irvine - 23009@burnside.school.nz
items.author: LCG

items.title: Recycling - Batteries and Colgate products
items.body: The school is now part of the Terracycling program. We are recycling Colgate products and used Batteries. Boxes can be found in the student office. Please support this Recycling venture.
